title: A Stained Glass Coloring Book
coverLines: Celebrating 100 Years of Our Church Building
intro: These drawings are based on the stained glass of First Congregational Church in Kalamazoo, Michigan.
Choose your own colors, or use the original photographs for ideas.
sourcesText: First Congregational Church, Kalamazoo. Our Church: Its History, Its Structure, Its Service (1928). Supplied transcription; original printed pagination has not been verified.

Mrs. Stanley Morris, assisted by Mrs. James M. Hatfield. First Congregational Church Centennial History 1835-1935 (October 1935). Supplied transcription. The section The Fourth Church 1928-1935 records the present building's dedication on 28 October 1928.
The cover celebrates the building's 1928-2028 century. The congregation began in 1835; the cover does not describe its founding centennial or date every stained-glass window to 1928.
Source photographs: the project owner's supplied collection of 55 photographs of the church's stained glass. The photographer's name is not established in the supplied records.

Coloring artwork: the 48 supplied final drawings, numbered 002-049, developed from the church photographs. Cover illustration: Design_01_Front.png from the supplied Combined Church Designs collection, showing the previous and present church buildings. Individual artist and tool credits are not established in the supplied records.
The cover illustration is converted from white linework on black to black linework on white, without redrawing the buildings. The source drawings and photographs remain unchanged.
